newsitem.title: FRANCE: Socialist Lang favours Fr Telecom capital opening.
newsitem.headline: Socialist Lang favours Fr Telecom capital opening.

text.p: Jacques Lang, a Socialist member of parliament, said on Sunday he backed opening up the capital of France Telecom.

"France Telecom is a fine company but nevertheless needs to to acquire international size and forge alliances with a number of other large companies which are all partially or totally privatised," Lang told RTL radio.
"The question is whether France Telecom can genuinely become a competitive company in terms of research and development and size if we block an opening up for too long," he said.
"My personal response is that an opening of its capital should be considered," said Lang, head of the National Assembly's foriegn affairs commission.

The former centre-right government had planned to sell part of France Telecom this month but the move has been halted with the return to power on June 1 of Prime Minister Lionel Jospin's Socialist-led coalition government.
The Left gave mixed signals during the election campaign and the government has yet to decide how to proceed but it is widely believed to be veering towards a partial sale.

A government source said last week that Finance and Industry Minister Dominique Strauss-Kahn had told Socialist members of parliament in a closed-door meeting: "Personally, I'm not against the opening of the capital on the condition that the promises of the prime minister are taken into account."
